bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for product price text
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the price values displayed in gray text
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Price text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the white background (or 3:1 if considered large text).
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Price text uses #bdbdbd on #ffffff, yielding a contrast ratio of 1.87:1, which fails the required minimum.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for .result:nth-child(3) > div > span, change color from #bdbdbd to #757575 (4.61:1 on #ffffff; measured 1.87:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Product images missing alternative text on search results page
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the product images (e.g., shoe-trail.jpg, shoe-road.jpg, shoe-light.jpg)
Inspect each element with the browser dev tools
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each element must have a text alternative via a descriptive alt attribute, or be marked as decorative with alt="" or role="presentation".
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The elements for shoe-trail.jpg, shoe-road.jpg, and shoe-light.jpg have no alt attribute, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, no title, and no role override, leaving them without an accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image, e.g., html If any image is purely decorative, use `alt=""` or `role="presentation"` instead.

bugLogs.title: Missing accessible name on pagination link
steps_to_reproduce: Tab to the next page link
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The link must have discernible text or an accessible name so screen readers can announce its purpose (e.g., “Next page”).
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <a> element has no visible text, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, and no title attribute, leaving it nameless to assistive technologies.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add an accessible name, e.g., or include visible text like Next.

bugLogs.title: Select element #sort lacks an accessible name
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the sort dropdown near the top of the page
Attempt to navigate to the dropdown using a screen reader or keyboard
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The select element should have a programmatically determinable accessible name that is announced by screen readers (e.g., via a visible label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <select id="sort"> element has no associated <label>, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, and no title attribute, resulting in no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a visible label element and associate it with the select, e.g., <label for="sort">Sort results by</label> before the <select id="sort">, or alternatively add aria-label="Sort results by" to the select element.
